value.rationale: Determines the first cooperative obstruction, exact energy spectrum and two distinct thermodynamic-scale entropies in a natural frustrated Ising wheel. Full 3-flip classification adds a physically motivated local-minimum filter that is not implied by pre-existing one-spin Perrin coding. Positive pressure gap quantitatively measures loss of metastable states; not a routine small-parameter gain.
